name: Accordion Bellows Canyon
description: A slot canyon where walls expand and contract like accordion bellows, breathing with the wind — each exhale releases clouds of colored dust that paint the sandstone in shifting patterns.
prompt: Narrow slot canyon with walls structured like accordion bellows — pleated sandstone expanding and contracting rhythmically, wind rushes through creating visible breathing motion, each exhale releases clouds of colored mineral dust (ochre, umber, sienna, rose) that settle in shifting patterns on walls, light beams penetrate from above illuminating dust clouds, geological time visible in strata, sense of immense slow breathing, photorealistic textures, 8k, vertical composition emphasizing height and rhythm
caption:
The earth breathes. And every breath paints the walls anew. 🌬️🏜️

Listen. The canyon has been inhaling for millennia.
